يفترسون (form VIII)
# يَفْتَرِسُونَ (yaftarisūna) /jaf.ta.ri.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# يُفْتَرَسُونَ (yuftarasūna) /juf.ta.ra.suː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
